sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding an impressive run of five consecutive wins, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Alsager are struggling near the foot of the division in 20th place with just 4 points from 10 games, having lost their last five matches, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their commanding lead.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town in a clash between mid-table sides, with both teams seeking to maintain momentum in pursuit of the leaders. The title race intensifies further as third-placed AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall (5th), a fixture that could significantly impact the upper reaches of the table. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the standings, host Wednesfield Community (9th) in a local derby. In-form Bilston Town (6th), who have won their last two, visit Foley Meir (13th) looking to climb higher. Barnton (7th) make the trip to face Shawbury United (15th), who are in poor form with just one win in their last six. Market Drayton Town host New Mills (10th v 8th) in a mid-table encounter, while Crewe, in 16th with only one win in their last six, host Allscott Heath (11th). The basement battle intensifies as Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th) travel to Telford Town (18th), both desperately seeking wins, and Widnes Town (20th, pointless) make the trip to Brereton Social (14th) in a fixture between struggling teams.
